seo.title: Solar Lighting & Energy Storage Manufacturer for Mexico | GULAI
seo.description: GULAI supplies solar street lights, solar flood lights and energy storage products to qualified importers and distributors in Mexico.

topbar.message: China manufacturer · Focused on qualified importers in Mexico

hero.title: Solar lighting for importers in Mexico.
hero.copy: Solar street lights, flood lights and energy storage supplied from China for distributors and project buyers in Mexico who can import directly.
hero.note: Samples & trial orders · Small batches by model · OEM / ODM

about.title: Coordinated in Shenzhen. Produced in Guangdong.
about.copy: GULAI coordinates orders from its Shenzhen headquarters and works with production facilities in Zhongshan and Huizhou. We focus on Mexican businesses able to import from China.

products.intro: Explore both product lines and open each catalogue. If you already know the model or quantity you need, you can share them when you message us.
products.note: Catalogue images and model references are for product selection. Availability, detailed specifications, OEM/ODM options and compliance documents are subject to final order confirmation.
